recap.back_html: An F SKU with 64 capacity units. F SKUs run from F2 to F2048.
Need an F64 or larger (or P) capacity. Smaller F SKUs need Pro, PPU or trial licences for viewers.
recap.front_html: Free-licence viewers of Power BI content

recap.back_html: Stops compute billing from then on, bills remaining smoothed and overage usage at once, and stops its items.

lessons.takeaway_html: The capacity decides who can view, how much runs at once and what it costs. Separate environments into workspaces, and give production its own capacity.
lessons.title: Tenant, capacity, workspace and item

recap.back_html: Exactly one. You cannot create or delete OneLakes.
Delta Parquet or Iceberg, open formats every Fabric engine reads.
They survive renames, avoid special-character problems in abfs URIs, and drop the item type.

lessons.takeaway_html: One lake, one copy, many engines. Address data by GUID in anything automated.
lessons.title: OneLake, one lake per tenant

recap.back_html: Update or delete the workspace, manage admins, connect Git, create a workspace identity.
Reads with T-SQL (ReadData). Not through Spark or OneLake APIs (ReadAll starts at Contributor).
An automation identity as Contributor. People get Viewer, through groups.

lessons.takeaway_html: Roles go to groups, write access in production goes to automation, and people read.
lessons.title: Workspace roles, granted to groups

summary: Workspaces, capacities, items and OneLake as one logical lake.
